{{For|the game|Ooblets (game)}}


'''Ooblets''' are the cute and bizarre creatures that populate the land of Oob. They can be grown on your farm from Ooblet seeds. They take a certain amount of time to grow but soon after, the Ooblet will emerge from its plant.

Initially, the player may have a maximum of 12 Ooblets, up to 8 of which can be allocated as "Follow Babies," who will follow the player around and participate in [[Dance Battle|dance battles]]. Non-Follow Babies will remain on the [[farm]] as "Home Babies". This capacity can be increased by placing and upgrading [[Oobcoop|Oobcoops]].

== Rarity ==
All Ooblets come in common, uncommon and gleamy variants.


[[File:Shrumbo standard .jpg|thumb]]

===== Common =====
The most widespread, "default" coloration of an Ooblet. This type of Ooblet is really common among the regions. The spawn rate of Common Ooblets is 359/400 (89.75%).

===== Uncommon =====
Show up only occasionally, sporting alternate colorations from their standard counterparts. Uncommon 0oblets are not that rare. The spawn rate of Uncommon Ooblets is 40/400 (10%).

===== Gleamy =====
{{Quote|Hope you're having a good time adjusting to town! Just thought I'd mention in case you hadn't heard that there are some super rare ooblets to be found if you look hard enough😏. They're called "gleamies" and they SPARKLE.|Letter from [[Outgrid]]}}
The rarest of all, exhibiting more vibrant color schemes, sparkles, and rainbow trails that follow as they walk. Gleamies appear more frequently during Rainbow Rain, and they have a chance to produce [[Oobsidian]] when left on the farm. The spawn rate of Gleamy Ooblets is 1/400 (0.25%).

===== Spawn Rates of Each Rarity =====
Each time an Ooblet spawns, it has a chance to be any of the three rarities based on the odds below:
{| class="wikitable"
! Rarity !! Odds !! Percentage
|-
| Common || 359/400 || 89.75%
|-
| Uncommon || 40/400 || 10%
|-
| Gleamy || 1/400 || 0.25%
|}

== Cultivation ==
[[File:Ooblet_being_born.png|alt=|300x300px|thumb|An [[Isopud]] sprouting from its fully-grown seed.]]
There are two main ways to obtain Ooblet seeds

===== '''[[Dance Battle|Dance Battles]]''' =====
Upon winning a [[Dance Battle|dance battle]], the player is given the option to aquire a seed. If the player chooses to do so, they will comfort the disheartened ooblet, causing it to produce a seed matching its rarity.

===== '''Gifts''' =====
[[Badgetown#Befriendable NPCs|Befriendable NPCs]] may gift the player an Ooblet seed when increasing their friendship at a certain level.
